description: This file contains utility classes and functions for processing window manager trace entries related to input method (IME) layers in Android. It defines classes for processed window states, IME layers, and utility methods for extracting and transforming IME-related data from trace entries.

classes.name: ProcessedWindowManagerState
classes.description: Represents a processed snapshot of the window manager state with focus and IME details.

classes.name: ImeLayers
classes.description: Encapsulates layers related to IME, including container, input surface, focused window, and task layers.

classes.name: ImeUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for processing window manager trace entries, extracting IME layers, and transforming input connection calls.

methods.name: processWindowManagerTraceEntry
methods.description: Processes a WindowManagerState trace entry to extract focus and IME visibility information.

methods.name: getImeLayers
methods.description: Extracts IME-related layers from a trace entry and processed window manager state.

methods.name: transformInputConnectionCall
methods.description: Cleans up an input connection call object by removing properties without values.

methods.name: findAncestorTaskLayerOfImeLayer
methods.description: Finds the ancestor task layer of a given IME layer within a trace entry.

methods.name: getImeControlTargetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the IME control target property from a display content proto.

methods.name: getImeInputTargetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the IME input target property from a display content proto.

methods.name: getImeLayeringTargetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the IME layering target property from a display content proto.

methods.name: findAnyPropertyWithMatchingName
methods.description: Finds a property in an object that matches any of the provided possible names.

methods.name: isInputMethodVisible
methods.description: Determines if an input method window or layer is visible within a display content.
